name: live_like_on_nullable_operand_is_null
description: LIKE over a nullable column is observed NULL against a live engine, not merely asserted from the model -- the #163 gap: no live fixture exercised LIKE at all, so a fix that only changed the analyzer's model of NULL LIKE 'x' could regress silently
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
query_sql:
-- @name LikeOnNullableEmail
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, email LIKE 'a%' AS starts_with_a FROM users ORDER BY id

columns.name: starts_with_a
columns.note: email is nullable, so email LIKE 'a%' is NULL (not false) when email IS NULL

default: INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (1, 'Ada Lovelace', 'ada@example.com')
INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (2, 'Grace Hopper', NULL)
